# AdaptiveMeasurementProtocol

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A feedback-based strategy where measurement outcomes guide subsequent unitary operations to steer the system toward a desired topological state. Enables deterministic preparation of topological phases in noisy or dynamic environments, relevant for robust information processing in TCC/iNEST architectures.
